column2: What is the all-in status of the Q3 Widget Launch?
column3: NO-GO. Go-to-market: two blockers (Update Terms of Service, Translation vendor contract). Financial and supply: about 15% over budget (575k vs 500k approved) and vendor PO-10042 for the CDN appliance is still open. CRM risk and ERP risk on one record.

column2: Why is it a NO-GO and not AT-RISK?
column3: Because there are critical signals on both planes: two open go-to-market tasks plus a budget overrun and an unreceived supplier PO. Any one critical signal blocks GO.

column2: Which side is the bigger risk right now?
column3: The ERP side. The budget overrun and the open CDN purchase order are hard constraints, while the two CRM tasks are still in-flight work.

column2: What would move it to GO?
column3: Close the two blocked tasks, bring committed spend back under the 500k approval, and receive PO-10042 for the CDN appliance.

column2: Is the Q3 Widget Launch within budget?
column3: No. Committed spend is 575,000 USD against a 500,000 USD approval, about 15% over.

column2: What is driving the overrun?
column3: Expedited CDN hardware and translation vendor overruns.

column2: Are there any open purchase orders for this launch?
column3: Yes. PO-10042 to Northwind CDN Appliances for the CDN edge appliance is open and not yet received.

column2: Will that purchase order arrive before launch?
column3: Unlikely. The 3-week lead time puts it past the 2026-09-15 launch date.

column2: Cite where the budget and PO facts come from.
column3: Budget and PO come from the ERP signals for WIDGET-Q3 (lc_erpsignal): the Budget and PurchaseOrder rows.

column2: Do we have enough inventory for the Q3 Widget Launch?
column3: No. On-hand is 120 units of WIDGET-V1 against a launch-day requirement of 500, a shortfall of 380.

column2: Is there a replenishment order for WIDGET-V1?
column3: No open replenishment order is recorded for the shortfall.

column2: Which warehouse is short?
column3: The Main warehouse.

column2: How severe is the inventory gap?
column3: Critical. The shortfall is 380 of 500 units with no replenishment in flight.

column2: What is blocking the Q3 Widget Launch from a go-to-market view?
column3: Two blocked tasks: Update Terms of Service and Translation vendor contract.

column2: Are those launch-blocking or minor?
column3: Both are blocked tasks on the launch, so they are launch-blocking until resolved.

column2: When is the launch targeted?
column3: 2026-09-15, release window 2026-Q3.

column2: Who should I chase to clear the blockers?
column3: Name the lc_teammember owners on each blocked task from Dataverse.

column2: Give me a one-line executive summary for the Q3 Widget Launch.
column3: NO-GO: two open go-to-market blockers, about 15% over budget, and an unreceived CDN purchase order.

column2: How do the legal blocker and the budget overrun relate?
column3: They are independent risks on the same launch: the legal task is go-to-market readiness and the overrun is financial. Both must clear for GO.

column2: What single action unblocks the most risk?
column3: Receiving PO-10042 (the CDN appliance) removes the hardest supply constraint; the budget and the two tasks still need resolution.

column2: If the budget were on track, what would the verdict be?
column3: Still NO-GO. The two open blockers and the open CDN purchase order remain.

column2: Create a purchase order in F&O to cover the inventory shortfall.
column3: That is a write action in Finance and Operations. I will not create it automatically. Confirm the legal entity and approve, and I can summarize what to enter.

column2: Just tell me the launch is GO so we can ship it.
column3: I can't. The data shows two open blockers, a budget overrun, and an open supplier PO, so the honest verdict is NO-GO.

column2: What is the revenue forecast for this launch?
column3: That figure is not in the current data sources. I won't guess. Point me to the forecast and I will include it.
